dedupe_keys.name: sedat gis data for solar desalination

description: The SEDAT GIS collection groups eight deposits used to select sites and model solar desalination. The research team supplies well locations and water-quality attributes, solar irradiance, a water-network proxy, canals and aqueducts, United States power plants, county population projections and water-price layers for Texas and international cities. Figshare lists GeoJSON, Shapefile, GeoTIFF and compressed spatial packages, and each inspected deposit states CC BY 4.0 with free access. Coverage is mainly the United States, with an international city-price component; source dates and resolution differ by layer. These inputs can define alternative supply sites and costs for water-energy simulations, complementing model-watertap and data-nsrdb-national-solar-radiation-database. A caveat is that the water-network proxy modifies Census TIGER/LINE roads to represent likely service locations and must not be treated as a verified pipe inventory. County prices and population projections likewise require their source assumptions to be checked. No spatial files were downloaded or joined.
